gameLocalization.note: Guide spacing and ellipsis variants are matched to paired game records. Withstand, Heart of Vengeance, and The Uninvited are scoped to avoid overriding names in other contexts.

lead.text: A long, 5-phase battle alternating between the Erlking and Catherine. Protect Heathcliff, bring the first pair of hands down together, and destroy Catherine's Shield as well on her second appearance.

listLead.text: A 5-phase endurance battle in which 2 enemies alternate. Protect the required Sinner, damage both hands together the first time, and handle the body's Shield on the second appearance.

statNote.text: 6-48 only. Lists the Erlking's 3 appearances and Catherine's 2 appearances with her hands separately. These forms do not appear simultaneously. Summons list both overall HP and part HP.

skillNote.text: Listed Power is before conditional modifiers. Some Attack Weights and effects are unspecified in the source and are marked unknown or annotated. Identically named attacks can differ by phase or hand; check the current user.

priorities.0.text: Heathcliff's death causes defeat. Aim for Lv.45 and Uptie III or higher, prioritizing his clashes and HP.

priorities.1.text: On Catherine's first appearance, bring both hands to 1 HP on the same turn. On her second, also break the main body's 300 Shield.

priorities.2.text: Continue handling area attacks after the final event. Heathcliff's survival effect does not protect the other Sinners.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Defeated while other allies were still alive

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Heathcliff's death is the defeat condition. Protect him until he gains his survival effect in the final phase. Even then, protection at 1 HP requires at least one other ally to remain alive. Also watch combinations of Identities that damage allies.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: This is not a normal main-body kill. Bring both hands to 1 HP. On her second appearance, then destroy the 300 Shield the main body gains to advance.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: A hand recovers after you thought it was defeated

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: The first pair's recovery triggers if only one hand is brought down early. Avoid overdamaging one hand; watch both HP values and bring them to 1 HP on the same turn.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: A Sinner with Lightning of Suffering becomes Staggered

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: Lightning weakens the enemy on Clash Win, but a clash loss or unopposed attack inflicts Breaking Heart and damage on its holder instead. Assign the holder to a winning clash.

phases.0.title.text: Develop Heathcliff as a main combatant

phases.0.steps.0.text: Deployment limit: 6; Heathcliff is mandatory. Aim for Lv.45 and Uptie III or higher, with Blunt resistance and skills that can win clashes.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Build SP and E.G.O resources during this regular stage. Give early winning clashes to your main combatants, and gather resources for healing E.G.O too.

phases.0.steps.2.text: If few Identities are developed, a smaller team can concentrate slots on earlier deployment positions. Check that you still have enough actions for area attacks and multiple hands.

phases.1.title.text: Aim for the main body's transition rather than clearing every summon

phases.1.steps.0.text: Wild Hunt summons are replenished up to 4 at once. All retreat when the main body reaches around 1707 HP, so you do not need to kill every summon each time.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Using You'll Get Shoved In This Coffin Too buffs the entire enemy team next turn. Save strong skills for the repeated Behead Heathcliffs attacks, and Stagger summons to reduce incoming attacks.

phases.1.steps.2.text: The Erlking targets Heathcliff. Heathcliff's clash wins can lower the enemy's SP, but let faster allies intercept dangerous attacks. Advance at 70% HP.

phases.2.title.text: Bring both hands to 1 HP together

phases.2.steps.0.text: The main body has 1 HP but is protected by 10 Protection and 0.2 resistances while a hand remains. Split attacks between the hands. You do not need to deplete the initial 404 Away With You.

phases.2.steps.1.text: If only one hand reaches 1 HP, it heals at the end of the following turn based on the other hand's HP. Damage both first, then bring both to 1 HP on the same turn.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Heathcliff has favorable modifiers, including −3 to the enemy's Clash Power. Beating Misery is All That Remains... adds Breaking Heart to the hand, helping Stagger it.

phases.2.steps.3.text: Both hands at 1 HP trigger an event. Gloom and Envy are favored, and Heathcliff has a check modifier. Success also heals everyone's SP.

phases.3.title.text: Assign the Lightning holder to clashes

phases.3.steps.0.text: A random Sinner receives Lightning of Suffering each turn. The Erlking loses 6 Power when clashing against that Sinner. Winning inflicts Breaking Heart on the enemy, causing Stagger at 3.

phases.3.steps.1.text: If the Lightning holder makes an unopposed attack or loses a clash, they gain Breaking Heart instead. Check the effects and take winning clashes.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Offset Withstand with a Defense Skill to let attacks through. At around 975 main-body HP, advance to Catherine's second appearance.

phases.4.title.text: Handle both hands, then break the main body's Shield

phases.4.steps.0.text: Bring both hands to 1 HP again. This time they leave at 1 HP and lack the first appearance's hand-recovery passive.

phases.4.steps.1.text: The main body's Breaking Heart is an area attack with max-HP-based damage. Stop it with a strong clasher to prevent forced Stagger on your side.

phases.4.steps.2.text: The event after the first turn favors Wrath and Envy, with a modifier for Heathcliff. Success also lowers both hands' Attack Power.

phases.4.steps.3.text: The turn after both hands are handled, the main body gains 300 Shield. Focus your saved attacks on it and fully break the Shield to enter the final phase.

phases.5.title.text: Advance the scripted sequence and endure while stopping area attacks

phases.5.steps.0.text: On entering the final phase, Heathcliff gains an effect that keeps him at 1 HP while at least one other ally is alive. The initial attack cannot be redirected or clashed with; advance to the event after Turn End rather than trying to stop it with a normal clash.

phases.5.steps.1.text: After the event, ordinary Identities gain Courage to Approach. The Wild Hunt Identity retains Faded Promise with the survival effect added. Both require another ally to survive, so prioritize responding to area attacks.

phases.5.steps.2.text: Sorrow and Lament In The Erlking's Wake. has a maximum of 20 and Attack Weight 7. Save a strong E.G.O to win, and recover HP and SP if needed.

phases.5.steps.3.text: The encounter ends when you deplete the main body's HP or reach the end of this phase's Turn 5. After the event, this means surviving roughly 4 more turns.

skills.0.response.text: Sinking buildup also enables later Bleed and Power conditions. Stop it with a winning clash and protect Heathcliff's SP.

skills.2.response.text: Summoning triggers On Use and cannot be stopped with a normal clash. Focus on advancing the main body to its next phase rather than clearing every summon.

skills.3.effects.2.text: [On Use] Grant 3 Attack Power Up and 3 Damage Up to all allies, including self, next turn.

skills.17.name.text: Sorrow and Lament In The Erlking's Wake.

skills.17.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Sinking and 4 Bleed.

skills.17.effects.1.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Sinking and Bleed Count by 2.

skills.17.effects.2.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Sinking and 4 Bleed.

skills.17.effects.3.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] Increase Sinking and Bleed Count by 2.

skills.17.response.text: An area attack with Attack Weight 7 and a maximum of 20. A reason to save high-Power E.G.O for the final phase. It also hits allies other than Heathcliff, so do not rely solely on his survival effect.

skills.18.effects.3.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal damage equal to 100% of the target's max HP.

skills.18.response.text: A scripted attack near the ending that cannot be redirected or clashed with. Do not try to overpower it with E.G.O as a regular instant-kill attack; advance Heathcliff's following event.

skills.19.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Defense Level Down next turn.

skills.19.response.text: Prevent next-turn Defense Level Down. Secure responses to the Erlking's dangerous clashes, then use spare actions to Stagger summons.

skills.20.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 2 negative effects, Base Power +1.

skills.20.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 3 Defense Level Down next turn.

skills.20.response.text: Gains Power against Sinners with many negative effects. Intercept with someone with healthy HP and SP.

skills.21.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 5 negative effects, Base Power +2.

skills.21.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 5 negative effects, damage +30%.

skills.21.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Fragile next turn.

skills.21.effects.4.text: [On Hit] If the target has at least 5 negative effects, reuse this Coin (2 times).

skills.21.effects.5.text: [On Hit] Remove 1 random removable negative effect from the target.

skills.21.response.text: Watch its bonuses and Coin reuse against targets with at least 5 debuffs. Do not let it hit a low-HP Sinner with many debuffs unopposed.

skills.22.response.text: Offset Evade with a Defense Skill. Do not spend all E.G.O needed for the Erlking's high-Power attacks just to kill summons.

skills.23.effects.0.text: Heal overall and Part HP by 10% of damage dealt by this Attack Skill.

skills.23.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up.

skills.23.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up.

skills.23.response.text: Hits enable healing and buffs. Exploit its weaknesses, such as Wrath, and focus damage during Stagger.

skills.24.effects.0.text: If faster than the target, gain +2 Clash Power.

skills.24.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.24.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 4 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.24.effects.3.text: [On Hit] If at least 3 Speed faster than the target, reuse this Coin once at most.

skills.24.response.text: The Speed difference strengthens its clash and reuse. Check current Power before assigning a slow Sinner.

skills.25.effects.0.text: Prioritize the target with the lowest current HP.

skills.25.effects.1.text: [On Use] If the target is below 70% of Max HP, gain +2 Clash Power.

skills.25.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Haste next turn.

skills.25.effects.4.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.25.effects.5.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.25.effects.6.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] If the target's “skill” is at least 20 (source wording; the intended value is unclear), damage +100%.

skills.25.effects.7.text: [On Kill] Reuse this skill once at most.

skills.25.response.text: A 4-Coin attack targeting low-HP Sinners. Protect them through healing or redirection, and prevent kill-triggered reuse. Its unclear extra-damage condition means the displayed maximum does not guarantee a safe hit.

skills.26.effects.0.text: At Turn End, if Shield remains, gain 4 Protection next turn.

skills.26.response.text: Remaining Shield grants 4 Protection next turn. If focusing attacks on it, fully break the Shield that turn; otherwise prioritize advancing the main body's phase.

skills.27.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn.

skills.27.effects.1.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Offense Level Up next turn.

skills.27.response.text: Prevent hit-triggered buffs for next turn. Balance actions spent on summons against damage to the main body.

skills.28.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has Offense Level Down, deal additional Blunt damage equal to 20% of damage dealt.

skills.28.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] If the target has Offense Level Down, deal additional Blunt damage equal to 20% of damage dealt.

skills.28.response.text: Hits enable healing and buffs. Exploit its weaknesses, such as Wrath, and focus damage during Stagger.

skills.29.effects.0.text: Prioritize the target with the most negative effects.

skills.29.effects.1.text: [Clash Win] Gain +1 Coin Power per 3 target Offense Level Down, up to 3.

skills.29.effects.5.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal +30% damage per 2 target Offense Level Down, up to 120%.

skills.29.effects.6.text: [Heads Hit] If the target has at least 3 negative effects, reuse this Coin once at most.

skills.29.response.text: Especially dangerous against Sinners with heavy Offense Level Down. Redirect and clash to prevent a chain of Paralyze and Fragile.

skills.30.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Gain 20 additional Shield per other living ally.

skills.30.response.text: More survivors mean a thicker Shield. You do not need to kill everyone, so avoid wasting too much damage on its defense.

skills.31.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has at least 5 Sinking Potency, inflict 1 Offense Level Down.

skills.31.response.text: Combines Sinking with next-turn Bind and Paralyze. Protect the actions of your reliable clashers.

skills.32.effects.0.text: [On Use] If the target has 10 SP or less, inflict 2 Offense Level Down.

skills.32.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Plus Coin Drop next turn.

skills.32.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Increase Sinking Count by 3.

skills.32.response.text: Winning the clash alone cannot prevent its On Use Offense Level Down. Avoid assigning a low-SP Sinner and prevent the additional On Hit debuffs.

skills.33.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Grant 3 Offense Level Up and heal 15 SP for all allies, including self.

skills.33.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] Inflict 1 Fragile on all other allies.

skills.33.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal additional Gloom damage equal to the target's Sinking Potency. Reduce Sinking Count by 1.

skills.33.effects.3.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal additional Gloom damage equal to the target's Sinking Potency. Reduce Sinking Count by 1.

skills.33.effects.4.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Deal additional Gloom damage equal to the target's Sinking Potency. Reduce Sinking Count by 1.

skills.33.effects.6.text: [On Hit] If the target has at least 3 Sinking Count, reuse this Coin up to 2 times.

skills.33.response.text: The Combat Start ally buffs activate even if you win the clash. Reuse against targets with heavy Sinking is dangerous; aim for redirection and an early Stagger.

skills.34.effects.0.text: At Turn End, if Shield remains, lower the Stagger Threshold by 50.

skills.34.response.text: Leaving Shield raises the difficulty of reaching its Stagger Threshold by lowering it. If a kill is difficult, damage the main body to end the summoning phase instead.

skills.35.response.text: While hands remain, Protection and resistances make the main body nearly impervious. On Catherine's first appearance, redirect main-body attacks to the hands. Attack the main body after its Shield appears on the second appearance.

skills.36.name.text: For a World Without His Suffering

skills.36.effects.1.text: [Combat Start] Grant 2 Fragile and 2 Attack Power Up to all other allies.

skills.36.effects.2.text: [Combat Start] Gain Bind (amount unspecified) and 5 Damage Up next turn.

skills.36.response.text: Cannot be clashed with; buffs the hands and other allies at Combat Start. Bring both hands close to 1 HP before the next area attack.

skills.37.effects.2.text: [Combat Start] Grant 2 Fragile and 2 Attack Power Up to all other allies.

skills.37.response.text: An Unclashable area attack. Damage becomes 0 when both hands have 1 HP, so adjust their remaining HP and attack order.

skills.38.response.text: Control follow-up damage while stopping necessary clashes so both hands reach 1 HP together.

skills.39.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.

skills.39.effects.1.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Bind next turn.

skills.39.response.text: Bind makes next-turn clashes harder to intercept. Protect fast clashers while damaging the hands.

skills.40.effects.1.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Offense Level Down next turn.

skills.40.response.text: Offense Level Down weakens later clashes. Assign a winning clasher while maintaining damage against both hands.

skills.41.response.text: Winning the clash inflicts Breaking Heart on that hand. Weaken it without taking the On Hit damage equal to 15% max HP. The second left hand's On Hit effect is unspecified in the source; do not assume it is identical.

warnings.0.text: Heathcliff's death causes immediate defeat. Even the final phase's protection at 1 HP requires at least one other ally alive. Watch combinations of effects that attack allies too.

warnings.1.text: Main-body HP floors and phase transitions limit damage. Even a large burst cannot necessarily finish the entire fight that turn.

warnings.2.text: Do not bring only one of the first hands down and leave it. Remember the main-body Shield on the second appearance too.

warnings.3.text: The final phase's turn count includes the initial turn before the event. It does not require another 5 turns after the event.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Lv.45 and Uptie III or higher. Check Heathcliff's development and Blunt resistance. Even when borrowing a strong support Identity, separately assess its survival after losing a clash.

preparation.1.text: Prepare HP and SP recovery for a long fight, and E.G.O that can stop the late area attack with a maximum of 20.

preparation.2.text: Gloom and Envy attacks are effective. The hands are also weak to Wrath and Lust; build a team that can split damage using your developed roster.

roles.0.reason.text: His survival directly determines defeat. His clash wins also weaken enemies, and he receives event check modifiers.

roles.1.reason.text: Several Sinners with strong skills make the fight more reliable, letting you stop area attacks even when the Lightning holder changes.

roles.2.reason.text: Split damage between left and right while maintaining HP and SP through the long fight.
